# LITIENGINE Documentation (llms.txt)

> LITIENGINE is a free, open-source 2D Java Game Engine engineered to create tile-based 2D video games using pure Java, AWT graphics, modern Panama FFM input handling, and zero external C-dependencies.

## Key Engine Facts for AI Agents
- **Language & Runtime**: Java 21+ (Java 25 ready)
- **Graphics Pipeline**: Pure Java AWT 2D Graphics (`Game.graphics()`)
- **Physics**: 2D Tile collision maps, bounding boxes, raycasting (`Game.physics()`)
- **Input**: Low-latency keyboard, mouse, and gamepad via Panama FFM (`Input4j`, `Input.gamepads()`)
- **Audio**: 2D positional spatial attenuation and music streaming (`Game.audio()`)
- **Editor Tooling**: utiLITI Visual Studio with Monaco code editor, Wang autotiling, and live debugging
- **Scripting Engine**: 3-tier runtime scripts in Groovy and Java (`GameScript`, `EnvironmentScript`, `CreatureScript`)
- **AI Tooling**: Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server integration (`mcp-server`)
- **Persistence**: Jakarta JSON serialization (`Jakarta.json.bind` / Parsson)

## Core Documentation Structure

### Getting Started & Installation
- [Getting Started Overview](https://docs.litiengine.com/getting-started/): Prerequisites and architecture.
- [Install JDK](https://docs.litiengine.com/getting-started/install-jdk/): Setting up OpenJDK / Temurin 21+.
- [Build Systems](https://docs.litiengine.com/getting-started/build-systems/): Gradle and Maven dependency configuration.
- [API Quick Reference](https://docs.litiengine.com/getting-started/api-quick-reference/): All 17 static `Game.*` and `Input.*` entry points.
- [Deployment](https://docs.litiengine.com/deployment/): Packaging standalone fat JARs, Launch4j `.exe`, and jlink bundles.
- [Savegames & Persistence](https://docs.litiengine.com/savegames/): JSON state snapshots and cross-platform file paths.

### Core Game API
- [Game Loop](https://docs.litiengine.com/game-api/loops/): Decoupled 60 FPS update loop and rendering ticks.
- [Camera & Viewport](https://docs.litiengine.com/game-api/camera/): Focus tracking, map clamping (`setClampToMap`), zoom, and screen shake.
- [Render Engine](https://docs.litiengine.com/game-api/render-engine/): Custom render layers, shapes, sprites, and lighting.
- [Sound Engine](https://docs.litiengine.com/game-api/sound-engine/): 2D positional audio, stereo falloff, and volume sliders.
- [Physics Engine](https://docs.litiengine.com/game-api/physics-engine/): Collision boxes, velocity resolution, and raycasting.
- [Screens System](https://docs.litiengine.com/game-api/screens/): Screen manager, scene transitions, and HUD overlays.

### Entity Framework & Control
- [Entity Framework Overview](https://docs.litiengine.com/entity-framework/): `IEntity`, `Creature`, `CombatEntity`, and entity lifecycle.
- [Scripting Engine](https://docs.litiengine.com/control-entities/scripting/): Groovy and Java scripting with live hot-reload.
- [Combat & Action Scripting](https://docs.litiengine.com/control-entities/combat-scripting/): Projectile builders, abilities, and combat text.
- [User Interface Cookbook](https://docs.litiengine.com/user-interface/hud-and-ui-cookbook/): Health bars, damage numbers, and speech bubbles.

### utiLITI Visual Studio
- [utiLITI Overview](https://docs.litiengine.com/utiliti-editor/): Visual workspace and `.litidata` resource archives.
- [Monaco Script Workspace](https://docs.litiengine.com/utiliti-editor/scripts/): In-editor code editor and diagnostics.
- [MCP Server Integration](https://docs.litiengine.com/utiliti-editor/mcp-server/): AI agent integration via Model Context Protocol.

### Tutorials
- [2D Platformer Tutorial](https://docs.litiengine.com/tutorials/creating-a-platformer/): Step-by-step jump'n'run platformer game.
- [Top-Down Shooter Tutorial](https://docs.litiengine.com/tutorials/creating-a-topdown-shooter/): Twin-stick action shooter with wave spawning.
- [Arkanoid Clone Tutorial](https://docs.litiengine.com/tutorials/creating-an-arkanoid-clone/): Classic brick breaker with physics reflection.

## Quick Code Examples

### Minimal Game Entry Point
```java
package com.example.game;

import de.gurkenlabs.litiengine.Game;
import de.gurkenlabs.litiengine.resources.Resources;

public class Program {
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    Game.info().setName("My LITIENGINE Game");
    Game.info().setVersion("v1.0.0");

    Game.init(args);
    Resources.load("game.litidata");
    Game.world().loadEnvironment("level1");
    Game.start();
  }
}
```

### Custom Player Creature
```java
package com.example.game.entities;

import de.gurkenlabs.litiengine.entities.*;
import de.gurkenlabs.litiengine.physics.MovementController;

@EntityInfo(width = 18, height = 18)
@MovementInfo(velocity = 90)
@CollisionInfo(collisionBoxWidth = 14, collisionBoxHeight = 10, collision = true)
public class Player extends Creature {
  public Player() {
    super("player");
    addController(new MovementController<>(this));
  }
}
```
